description: Deletes one sealed record from the caller's own repository in a space. The deletion is kept as a change so other devices learn about it.

main.description: Deletes one sealed record from the caller's own repository in a space. Deleting a key with no live record changes nothing and returns the current sequence number.

swapCid.description: Delete only if the current record has this CID.

seq.description: The deletion's sequence number. For a key with no live record, the repository's current sequence number: the existing tombstone's, or 0 in an empty repository.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: The space isn't the caller's own, answered exactly as for a missing record.
